announcement.title: 🎬 Cinematic Cut-ins v2.0.8
announcement.content:
v2.0.8: D&D5e 6 Compatibility

  • Fixed On Use cut-ins not playing with D&D5e 6.x chat cards, including with Midi-QOL enabled. Older chat cards remain supported.
  • Template triggers now recognize Region-based templates, including older templates converted by Foundry V14.
  • Ability check titles now work with roll-keyword rules. Cinematic Inspector displays item names and descriptions from D&D5e 6.x cards.
  • Critical hits no longer run item keyword, dice, and formula rules twice, preventing duplicate cut-ins and macros.
  • With Midi-QOL enabled, associated check and save messages now apply their item dice, keyword, and formula conditions.
